dated_disclosures.relation: SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank each acquired about USD 25M of Circle shares at its NYSE listing; combined USD 50M.
dated_disclosures.uncertainty: The release does not identify primary versus secondary shares; cash proceeds to Circle are not established.

dated_disclosures.relation_2: SBI's disclosure says it invested in Ripple in 2016 and held approximately 9% Ripple equity at the time of the 2025 disclosure; it also identifies the SBI Ripple Asia JV.
dated_disclosures.classification_2: Ripple corporate equity/JV, not a disclosed XRP token holding.
dated_disclosures.uncertainty_2: Dated disclosure, not a current independently verified cap table.

dated_disclosures.relation: SBI VC Trade and Ripple announced RLUSD availability through VCTRADE after Japanese regulatory approval; SBI classifies it as a No.4 electronic payment instrument and identifies Standard Custody & Trust Company as issuer.
dated_disclosures.launch_limit: VCTRADE supported Ethereum-chain RLUSD only at launch; this is not asserted as current chain support.

dated_disclosures.relation: Ripple announced RLUSD trading/management on Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Retail, with XRPL, Base and Ethereum support.
dated_disclosures.collateral_status: Coinbase Global Exchange collateral availability was stated to follow; not live at launch.

dated_disclosures.relation: BNY announced XRP and RLUSD support on Digital Asset Custody for eligible clients; it identifies itself as RLUSD primary reserve custodian and cites a Ripple Prime custody relationship.
dated_disclosures.limitation: No XRP-specific AUC, balances, collateral utilization or settlement volume disclosed.

dated_disclosures.relation: SBI Shinsei Trust Bank began allocating JPY 10B of JPYSC trust assets to short-term Japanese government bonds; JPYSC issuance outstanding was about JPY 20.1B.
dated_disclosures.lending: JPYSC Lending application amount was about JPY 6.9B; applications are not verified loans or deployed lending capital.
dated_disclosures.roles: SBI Shinsei Trust Bank is issuer/trust-asset manager; SBI VC Trade is issuing委託者 and distribution/access provider.
dated_disclosures.not_xrp: JGB allocation and JPYSC issuance are not XRP purchases or XRP collateral.

dated_disclosures.relation: SBI Holdings and Startale joined Open Standard, described as having 140+ participants including Coinbase, Visa, Stripe, Mastercard and BlackRock; they are considering a JPYSC-OpenUSD interoperability proof of concept.
dated_disclosures.uncertainty: Shared consortium participation is not a bilateral SBI-Coinbase agreement, production integration or XRP settlement; Ripple and Circle are not named as counterparties in this announcement.
